title: Peptoid-Ligated Pentadecanuclear Yttrium and Dysprosium Hydroxy Clusters

material_class.structural_family: pentadecanuclear {Ln15(μ3-OH)20Cl}24+ hydroxy cluster of five vertex-sharing {Ln4(μ3-OH)4}8+ cubanes

synthesis.procedure: PepCO2H·HCl (647 mg, 1.96 mmol, 0.59 equiv) was suspended in a stirred solution of KOtBu (1.017 g, 8.79 mmol, 2.67 equiv) in methanol (20 mL) and stirred for 30 min at room temperature. A solution of [YCl3·(H2O)6] (1.00 g, 3.30 mmol, 1.00 equiv) in methanol (20 mL) was added dropwise. After stirring for a further 45 min, DBMH (503 mg, 2.20 mmol, 0.67 equiv) in methanol (20 mL) was added slowly. The turbid mixture was stirred overnight at room temperature, filtered, and the filtrate evaporated to dryness. The residue was dissolved in DMF (3 mL), undissolved salt was filtered off, and slow diffusion of water into the mother liquor under reduced pressure gave colorless single crystals of 3 after two weeks (540 mg).
synthesis.time: 30 min deprotonation; 45 min after metal addition; overnight stirring; crystals after two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution in methanol; crystallization by slow diffusion of water into DMF under reduced pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration of the reaction mixture, evaporation of the filtrate, redissolution in DMF (3 mL), filtration of undissolved salt, then slow diffusion of water under reduced pressure to give colorless crystals (540 mg).

material_class.structural_family: pentadecanuclear {Ln15(μ3-OH)20Cl}24+ hydroxy cluster of five vertex-sharing {Ln4(μ3-OH)4}8+ cubanes

synthesis.procedure: The same procedure as for 3 was used with [DyCl3·(H2O)6] (1.24 g, 3.30 mmol, 1.00 equiv) in place of the yttrium salt. PepCO2H·HCl (647 mg, 1.96 mmol, 0.59 equiv) was treated with KOtBu (1.017 g, 8.79 mmol, 2.67 equiv) in methanol (20 mL) for 30 min at room temperature, the dysprosium salt in methanol (20 mL) was added dropwise, and after 45 min DBMH (503 mg, 2.20 mmol, 0.67 equiv) in methanol (20 mL) was added. Overnight stirring at room temperature, filtration, evaporation, redissolution in DMF (3 mL), and slow diffusion of water under reduced pressure gave yellow single crystals of 4 after two weeks (964 mg).
synthesis.time: 30 min deprotonation; 45 min after metal addition; overnight stirring; crystals after two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution in methanol; crystallization by slow diffusion of water into DMF under reduced pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration, evaporation, redissolution in DMF, filtration of undissolved salt, then slow water diffusion under reduced pressure to give yellow crystals (964 mg).

properties.summary: Compound 4 is ferromagnetically coupled below 11 K and shows slow magnetic relaxation below 8 K, indicative of SMM behavior. Zero-field ac signals do not reach maxima down to 1.8 K; under 2000 Oe the relaxation follows an Arrhenius law with Δ = 9.2 K and τ0 = 3.5×10−6 s.
